#### Question 1 part d)

```{r}
# Transition matrix p from part (a)

# Define transition matrix (rows = from, cols = to, states 0,1,2,3,4)
p <- matrix(c(
  0,   1,   0,   0,   0,
  1/3, 0,   2/3, 0,   0,
  0,   1/2, 0,   1/2, 0,
  0,   0,   2/3, 0,   1/3,
  0,   0,   0,   1,   0
), nrow = 5, byrow = TRUE)

# Compute p^50 using matrix exponentiation
library(expm)
p50 <- p %^% 50

# Starting at X0 = 2 (index 3 since R is 1-indexed)
q0 <- c(0, 0, 1, 0, 0)
q50 <- q0 %*% p50

# Stationary distribution from part (b)
pi_stat <- c(1/12, 3/12, 4/12, 3/12, 1/12)

# Print results
cat("q50:\n")
cat(round(q50, 6), "\n\n")
cat("Stationary distribution pi:\n")
cat(round(pi_stat, 6), "\n\n")

# Plot both
states <- 0:4
plot(states, pi_stat, type = "b", col = "green", pch = 16, lwd = 2,
     ylim = c(0, 1), xlab = "state i", ylab = "probability",
     main = "q50(i) vs stationary distribution pi(i)")
lines(states, q50[1,], type = "b", col = "blue", pch = 17, lwd = 2)
legend("topright",
       legend = c("pi(i) stationary", "q50(i)"),
       col = c("green", "blue"), pch = c(16, 17), lwd = 2)
```

#### Question 3 Part c)

```{r}
# Solve ln(x) = 2x - 2
f <- function(x) log(x) - 2*x + 2
root <- uniroot(f, interval = c(0.001, 0.999))
cat("p =", round(root$root, 6), "\n")
```

#### Question 4 part b)

```{r}
a <- 0.49
n_sim <- 1000
max_gen <- 200

extinct <- 0

for (i in 1:n_sim) {
  X <- 1
  for (gen in 1:max_gen) {
    if (X == 0) break
    Z <- rbinom(1, size = X, prob = 1 - a)
    X <- 2 * Z
  }
  if (X == 0) extinct <- extinct + 1
}

sim_rho <- extinct / n_sim
theoretical_rho <- a / (1 - a)

cat("Simulated extinction probability: ", round(sim_rho, 4), "\n")
cat("Theoretical rho = a/(1-a):        ", round(theoretical_rho, 4), "\n")
```
